model.name: deploymentModel.typedOopRefs
model.description: Build the typed OOP deployment model: each ref a first-class typed M1 node instanceOf its M2 type; IS-A (generalization) + implements (realizes) as real Relationship EDGES reusing UmlGeneralization/UmlDependency/UmlInterface; every FileBacked realizer manifestsAs a real file (crown invariant, fail-closed model query). Renders via renderFacet (R40.2). Reuses the M2 family, no parallel type system.
